level1.title: This Week's Catholic Virtue: Prudence
level1.story: Prudence means thinking carefully before you speak or act: Is this a good choice?
level1.heartIntro: Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice prudence all week. On Saturday, talk together, write what you practiced, and a parent signs.
questions: What good choice did we think through this week?
How can we stop and think before we act?
actions: Hang this sheet on the fridge
level1.prayer: Holy Spirit, help me think before I act and choose what is good. Amen.

activity.title: Daily Action Checklist
activity.intro: Color a star each day, Monday through Saturday. Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice with your family. A parent signs at the end of the week.
items: MON: Stop and think before you speak
TUE: Ask a parent before doing something new
THU: Choose a good show or game
FRI: Think about how your words will feel
SAT: Ask the Holy Spirit to help you choose

level2.title: This Week's Catholic Virtue: Prudence
level2.story: Prudence means thinking carefully about whether a word or an action is a good choice before we say or do it. It means stopping, thinking, and choosing wisely. The Book of Proverbs says the wise person considers his steps. Prudence helps us avoid danger, choose good friends, and do what is right in each situation. The Holy Spirit helps us with good judgment.
level2.heartIntro: Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice prudence all week. On Saturday, talk together, write what you practiced, and a parent signs.
questions: What good choice did we think through this week?

actions: Hang this sheet on the fridge
